condo: Super Cheap Freehold 4 Bedroom Mins walk to MRT

history.summary: A young (2021) freehold 4BR of 1281 sqft at $2029 PSF / $2.6M, 510m from the new TE26 Marine Parade MRT in D15 East Coast. No URA appreciation/median data is attached, so the value case rests on the location and the East Coast freehold premium rather than project-specific evidence.
history.rating_rationale: Strong location (freehold East Coast, 6 min to a TEL station that opened the area up) and a compact-but-functional 1281 sqft 4BR. But $2.6M sits above the deepest liquidity band, $2029 PSF is full price for the area, and the listing carries zero URA appreciation/txn data — no project-specific evidence of price trajectory. The spammy 'Super Cheap' title is agent marketing, not a verified discount. Mid-pack score (564). Balanced risk/reward.
